title: Important: crun security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description:
crun is a OCI runtime

Security Fix(es):

* crun: crun: rootful krun with passt executes container payload as host root (CVE-2026-84042)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* crun should require container-selinux (JIRA:Rocky Linux-169227)

* update to the latest upstream release (JIRA:Rocky Linux-185741)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

Additional Changes:

For detailed information on changes in this release, see the Rocky Linux 9 Release Notes linked from the References section.
